popupHeightHelp: 100% fits the Home page, up to the browser limit. Larger values are disabled to avoid empty space; smaller values add scrolling.
popupWidthHelp: Changes window width without resizing text or controls. 100% is the standard width.
accountContextUnavailable: Cannot read this profile. Refresh the X tab to reconnect.
simplifiedDesignHelp: Off: neutral appearance. On: a soft color gradient and colorful accents.
textScaleHelp: Changes only text size. Each 5% step on the slider changes text by 3% of its base size.
uiScaleHelp: Resizes buttons, icons and spacing without changing text size or window width.
dateRangeHelp: **Dates use your browser’s time zone.** The start and end dates are included. If you select today, only posts published before the export started are included; Resume keeps that same cutoff. X search may show posts from nearby dates, but XPorter saves only posts within your selected period. **Keep the search tab open.**
whatToExport: What do you want to export?
whatToExportHelp: Select the post types to include in the file.
postTypeOriginalsHelp: **Posts published by this account that are not replies, quote posts, reposts, or articles.** Select those types separately.
postTypeQuotesHelp: **Posts that include another post with the author’s own comment.** Sharing a post without a comment counts as a repost.
postTypeRepliesHelp: **Replies by this account, including replies to other accounts and to its own posts.** Replies by other people are not included.
postTypeRepostsHelp: **Posts shared by this account without an added comment.** Posts shared with a comment count as quote posts.
postTypeArticlesHelp: **Posts published as X articles.** XPorter exports the full article text when X makes it available. The length of an ordinary post does not make it an article.
postSelectionMultiFeed: Only the post types you selected will be saved.
postSelectionRequired: Choose at least one type of post.
txtFormatHelp: Plain text for reading or using with AI tools. Includes post types, reply and quote context, metrics, dates, and links.
profileFeedHelp: **All matches X's All feed:** original posts, quotes, and replies that continue the author's own threads. **Replies uses X's Replies feed** for the author's replies to other accounts. Posts excludes replies. Reposts follow the separate switch.
includeBookmarkReplyContext: Include the posts that bookmarked replies respond to
includeBookmarkReplyContextHelp: **If a bookmark is a reply, includes the post it responds to in the same export record.** This does not increase the bookmark count, but requires extra requests to X. Some posts may be unavailable because they were deleted or access is restricted.
includeBookmarkArticlesHelp: **Includes article titles, links, and the article text available from X.** This also applies to articles in quoted posts and posts that a bookmarked reply responds to. If X provides only a preview, only that preview is saved.
embedPhotosHelp: **Available for XLSX files only.** Downloads photo previews from X and adds them to a separate sheet named Media. Each photo has its own row, including photos from quotes and replied-to posts. This takes more time and increases file size; large exports may be split into several XLSX files. Videos are included as links.
xlsxPhotosHelp: Save photo links only, or include images in the file.
xlsxPhotoLinksHelp: Saves links without the images. Creates a smaller file faster.
xlsxPhotoEmbedHelp: Adds small photo previews to the Media sheet. Takes longer and makes the file larger.
photoPermissionTitle: Allow downloads of photos from X
photoPermissionBody:
**This permission is optional and is only needed to embed photo previews in XLSX files.**

X stores post photos on **pbs.twimg.com**. Permission to access that site lets XPorter download photos for your export and add previews to the Media sheet.

Photos are processed in your browser and are not sent to the developer.

Your browser may ask for permission next. If you decline, you can still export files with photo links.
quantityLimitHelp: **The maximum number of posts or accounts to collect.** For example, 500 stops the export after 500 items. **Without a date filter, X usually makes about 3,200 recent posts available**, even if the profile shows more. Choosing no limit does not remove this restriction. Date-filtered exports use X search, whose results may also be incomplete. Availability varies for follower and following lists.
postsExportSpeedHelp: **Sets the interval between requests for posts and bookmarks:** about 2, 3, 4, 7, or 12 seconds. Standard uses 4 seconds. Choose Custom to enter another interval. If X limits requests, XPorter saves progress and retries automatically. If retries are exhausted, it pauses until you resume.
userListsExportSpeedHelp: **Sets the interval between requests for followers, following, and verified followers.** Start with Standard, or choose Custom to enter another interval. X may apply different limits to each list. XPorter saves progress and retries automatically; if retries are exhausted, you can resume later.
safetyBreakHelp: **Pauses the export after a set number of requests, then resumes automatically.** These breaks are optional and do not replace X’s request limits.
aboutDesc: Free export of X (Twitter) data to CSV, JSON, XLSX, or TXT.
statusRateLimitWait: X rate limit — progress saved. Requests allowed again in:
statusRateLimitSubtitle: X decided we are exporting too much and paused requests for about 15 minutes. This cannot be sped up. Progress is saved and XPorter continues on its own when the countdown ends, so you can leave this tab open and come back later.
statusRateLimitHelp: **X has temporarily limited requests on your account. Your collected data is saved.** X lifts the limit after a rolling window of about 15 minutes and tells XPorter the exact time; the countdown shows it. There is no faster way through, so the only thing to do is leave the tab open and wait. If X is still limiting when the countdown ends, XPorter waits again for as long as your “Wait for X to lift its limit” setting allows.
statusSafetyBreakSubtitle: XPorter is taking a scheduled break and will resume automatically.
statusSafetyBreakHelp: **This pause follows your Scheduled breaks setting.** It starts after the number of requests you selected. Progress is saved, and the export will resume automatically when the countdown ends.
errNotLoggedIn: Please log in to x.com first
errUserNotFound: Account not found. Check the username.
errAuthError: Could not verify your X login. Refresh x.com and try again.
errRateLimited: X rate limit — export paused. Progress is saved.
errStaleQuery: Updating the request to X and trying again…
errRepliesUnavailable: The Replies tab is temporarily unavailable
repliesUnavailableBody: XPorter could not load replies from X. No posts were collected. Retry, or continue without replies.
postsOnlyFallbackActive: Collecting the other selected post types. Replies will not be included.
postsOnlyFallbackComplete: Export complete. Replies were not included.
errEndpointFailed: Could not connect to X. Check that x.com opens, then try again.
autoExpireHelp: **Deletes locally saved export data after the selected number of hours to free space.** Only finished exports are deleted; a paused export that can still be resumed is kept until you finish or discard it. Entries remain in export history, but their deleted data can no longer be downloaded from XPorter. Posts from your feeds have their own Clear button and are not affected. Files you have already downloaded are not affected.
feedStatsDescription: Posts are saved on this device as you browse supported X feeds. Download the collected posts here as CSV or JSON. Collection makes no extra requests to X.
feedStatsEmpty: Your collection is empty. Posts will appear as you browse X feeds.
clearSeenConfirm: Delete all posts in this local collection? This will not delete any posts on X.
multipartDownloadHint: The export will download as {count} numbered {format} files, with up to {partSize} records per file.
largeExportCsvTip: CSV is recommended for the largest exports because it uses less memory.
errInvalidDateRange: Choose an end date on or after the start date.
errMaxRetries: All retry attempts failed. Try again later.
errAlreadyRunning: An export is already running — stop it first
errHistoryNotFound: This export is no longer in history.
errHistoryDataGone: The saved data for this export is no longer available. Start a new export to download it again.
errStorageFull: Storage is full — export stopped early. Download what was collected.
errDownloadInProgress: A download is already in progress
errCopyTooLarge: This export is too large to copy — download the numbered files instead
errCopyFailed: Could not copy — please try again
errSearchCapture: Could not read the search results.
rateLimitedResumeHint: X is still limiting requests and the wait budget is spent. Your progress is saved. Wait at least 15 minutes, then select Resume.
errEnterUsername: Enter an X username, or open a profile on x.com and reopen XPorter
ovNote: Keep this tab open. XPorter is scrolling it to collect posts.
ovRateLimited: X rate limit — requests allowed again in
contactTitle: Have a question or found a bug?
contactLead: Have a bug report, an idea, or a collaboration proposal? Message me on Telegram. I read every message and reply.
contactEmailSub: I check email less often and may miss your message.
update200Title: A new look and smoother exports
update200Body:
• New interface: clearer navigation, progress, buttons and help.
• Light, dark and colorful themes with a visual theme picker.
• Separate controls for window width and height, element size and text size.
• Improved date-range exports, partial-result handling, stopping and resuming.
• A reload button restores the account connection after extension updates.
• Clearer interface text and translations across all 14 languages.
• A new ladybug with a domed shell, smooth routes and jointed legs. It returns from the side after the splat fades; Settings keeps the squash count.
• Removed optional usage-statistics sharing and the diagnostic-report button. Uninstall feedback remains.
• Fixed saved export counts and downloads, rate-limit waiting, and preservation of paused exports during automatic cleanup. Improved emoji alignment on Windows and Linux.
update165Body: Fixed date-range exports that could stop incorrectly. Collected results are kept, and exports can resume without skipping or duplicating posts. Filenames now use the selected dates.
update164Body: The progress indicator and item count are easier to read. The Stop button takes less space, and TXT exports show Download and Copy side by side.
update151Title: Bookmark export and files without empty fields
update151Body: You can now export your bookmarks to CSV, JSON, XLSX, or TXT, with quoted posts, replied-to posts, article text, metrics, and optional photo previews. Empty fields and columns are omitted. TXT files identify which post each metric belongs to. Export retries, resuming, and popup help were also improved.
detailLocalTitle: Export files stay on your device
detailLocalBody: Export files are created in your browser. Their contents are not sent to the developer, and you do not need a separate XPorter account. XPorter also keeps usage counters locally. When the uninstall feedback page opens, it sends usage statistics separately from your exported data.
detailSessionBody: XPorter uses the X account you are already signed in to in this browser. It can export data available to that account, including your own bookmarks. You do not need to enter your X password in XPorter.
detailExportsBody: Export posts, your bookmarks, followers, following, and verified followers. Post files can include views, likes, reposts, replies, quotes, bookmark counts, dates, links, media information, and hashtags, when X provides them.
detailFormatsBody: Choose CSV for spreadsheets, XLSX for Excel with optional photo previews, JSON for structured data, or TXT for reading and working with AI tools. Files are created in your browser.
detailDatesBody: Export posts from a specific time window. Date-range exports open an X search tab and scroll it automatically to gather matching posts — just keep that tab open until it finishes.
detailResumeBody: XPorter saves progress during an export. Closing the popup does not stop collection. After stopping an export or restarting the browser, use Resume while its saved data is still available. Request-limit pauses are retried automatically; if retries are exhausted, you can try Resume later.
exportModeHelp:
What each mode exports:
**📝 Posts** — the post types selected on Home, with available metrics and context.
**🔖 Bookmarks** — posts saved by the X account you are currently using. XPorter opens that account’s Bookmarks page. You cannot choose a different account in this mode. Some data may be unavailable.
**👥 Followers** — accounts that follow the selected profile.
**➡️ Following** — accounts the selected profile follows.
**✓ Verified Followers** — followers returned by X’s verified-follower list.
rateBody: If XPorter **saved you time or made your work easier**, I’d appreciate a review. Tell others what you use it for and what you liked. I keep adding features, fixing bugs, and answering your questions while keeping XPorter **free**. **Your review supports that work** and helps others discover a useful tool.
rateAboutBody: If XPorter **saved you time or made your work easier**, I’d appreciate a review. Tell others what you use it for and what you liked. I keep adding features, fixing bugs, and answering your questions while keeping XPorter **free**. **Your review supports that work** and helps others discover a useful tool.
aboutSourceSub: XPorter’s source code is available on GitHub. You can read the code, report issues, suggest improvements, or contribute changes.
aboutSafetySub: XPorter uses your signed-in X account to read data. It does not publish posts, like posts, follow accounts, or change account settings. Requests include pauses, but X may still limit requests or temporarily restrict your account.
aboutAccountSpeedHelp: Sets how many “About this Account” requests run at once. Standard uses 5 simultaneous requests; Turtle uses 1. More simultaneous requests can be faster but may reach X’s limits sooner. Custom allows 1 to 50 simultaneous requests.
aboutAccountRetries: Wait for X to lift its limit
aboutAccountRetriesHelp: How long XPorter waits for X to lift a rate limit before pausing the export. When X limits requests it blocks them for a rolling window of about 15 minutes; nothing can shorten that, so the minimum is 15 minutes. XPorter waits until the reset time X reports, retries once, and repeats while this budget lasts. Progress is saved the whole time; if the budget runs out you can press Resume later. The maximum is 1,440 minutes, or 24 hours.
aboutEnableRiskTitle: Extra account details take longer to export
aboutEnableRiskBody:
Enable this only if you need the account’s country or region, Premium date, connection source, affiliated account, or the number and most recent date of username changes.

XPorter may send an extra request for each account. This can substantially slow the export, and X may limit requests or temporarily restrict the account you are using. This feature is experimental.
aboutRetryRiskBody:
This lets XPorter keep waiting and retrying for more than an hour after X limits requests. Each retry is one more request, and a very long session may increase the risk of a temporary account restriction.

Use it only if you accept that risk. A longer wait does not guarantee that the export will finish.
includeAboutAccountDetailsHelp:
Adds the available “About this Account” fields: country or region, Premium date, connection source, affiliated account, number of username changes, and date of the last change.

**This requires extra requests:** exporting 500 accounts can add up to 500 requests. It takes longer and may trigger X request limits or temporary account restrictions. Enable it only if you need these fields.
localizeHeadersHelp: **Uses the interface language for supported CSV and XLSX column headers.** Turn this off to keep the original field names, which can be useful for scripts and spreadsheet templates. JSON keys and TXT labels remain in English.
errSearchChanged: The search page changed during export.
errSearchBridge: Could not connect to the search tab.
errSearchWaiting: X did not respond to the search request.
errSearchResponse: X could not complete the search request.
errSearchInvalid: XPorter could not read the search data returned by X.
errSearchTooLarge: X returned more search data than XPorter can process in one response.
errSearchNetwork: The connection to X was interrupted during search.
errSearchStalled: XPorter could not confirm that all search results were collected.
noMatchingPosts: No matching posts were found for this period.
searchResumeHint: Select Resume to retry in a new search tab. Keep that tab open.
errSearchEndUnconfirmed: XPorter could not confirm that all search results were collected.
errDateExportRestart: This saved date-range export cannot be resumed with the current version. Download any saved data, then start a new export.
errExtensionTimeout: XPorter did not respond. Reopen the extension and try again.
errExtensionConnection: Could not connect to XPorter. Reopen the extension and try again.
errNoResume: No saved export to resume. Start a new export.
